output.summary: The claim was denied because the required 9‑month continuous enrollment was not demonstrated. Provide the missing enrollment record to satisfy the maternity waiting‑period clause.

items.text: Obtain and submit an official enrollment record showing continuous coverage for at least nine months prior to the service date.
Contact the member’s employer or benefits administrator to request the enrollment verification and forward it to the insurer within the appeal window.
If the enrollment record cannot be provided, the appeal will likely be denied because the waiting‑period requirement remains unmet.
